messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Service alert - hosted inference p95 latency > 3s across region-us-west. Error spike correlating with increase in streaming connections starting ~now. Root metric: streaming_active_connections up 3x, queued_token_ops rising. Please triage.
ryan_oncall: Acked. I'm looking. Any recent deploys?
deploy-bot: Deploy successful: release/2026-03-15-rt-optimizations (commit abc123). No rollback.
eli_sre: I'm seeing a subset of streaming workers with KV cache thrash and GPU memory spikes. Non-streaming RPCs mostly fine. Could be continuous-batching interacting badly with long-lived streams.
maya_devex: Customers reporting chat UIs freezing and reconnect storms. CS picked up three priority customers experiencing disruptions.
lina_pm: Which customers? Any paying customers in Dedicated? Need impact call.
john_cs: Affected: acme-marketing (hosted), zenhealth (hosted), one dedicated trial (sandbox). acme-marketing reported 40% failed messages in last 10m.
ryan_oncall: Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) throttle new streaming connections globally (reduce concurrent streams per API key), 2) gate streaming on a percent of traffic (e.g., 25%), 3) fallback to non-streaming (polling) responses for non-enterprise routes. We should avoid full shutdown to minimize breakage for critical customers. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
eli_sre: Agreed. Start with throttling new streams + progressive rollout of stream-disable header for low-tier keys. I'll push traffic shaping rule and a temporary quota tweak.
maya_devex: Can we deploy a header-based toggle so SDKs can gracefully fallback? Provide an endpoint so SDKs can check.
ryan_oncall: Yes — we have runtime toggle: POST /admin/runtime-flags/streaming:disable with JSON body {"scope":"prefix","value":"true","predicate":"tier:low"}. I'll run it for tier:free and tier:trial first.
ryan_oncall: Running command now:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example.internal/admin/runtime-flags/streaming:disable \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"scope":"tier:trial,free","value":"true","reason":"mitigate-streaming-thrash-1769801234"}'
```
eli_sre: I pushed a traffic shaping rule to ingress: new_streams_per_minute per API key = 6 (was 30). Also bumped per-key streaming token budget to 50k -> 20k to reduce long tails. Rolling across regions now.
ryan_oncall: Noting customer-impact: set incident tag "partial_stream_degrade". Maya/Jonh please send CS note to affected customers: explain graceful fallback to polling and estimated timeframe ~30-60m.
maya_devex: On it. Draft: "We are throttling streaming connections to stabilize latency. Your app may fall back to non-streaming responses temporarily. We're monitoring and will update every 15m"
john_cs: Sent to acme and zenhealth. Both acknowledged and requested ETA and workaround. Provided SDK hint: set polling interval to 500ms.
eli_sre: Observability: p95 latency down from 3.5s -> 1.8s in region-us-west after initial throttle. Streaming_active_connections trending down. Errors 500 -> 2xx mostly.
ryan_oncall: Good. Next: add routing fallback for requests with header `X-Prefer-NonStreaming: true` so product teams can toggle per-route. Config snippet:
```yaml
route_rules:
  - match: headers.X-Prefer-NonStreaming == "true"
    action: route_to: generate-v1
```
maya_devex: SDK teams notified to implement header and backoff.
lina_pm: For Dedicated customers, we won't change by default. If any dedicated instance is impacted, notify infra lead.
eli_sre: One dedicated trial had elevated swap but not critical. We didn't touch dedicated.
ryan_oncall: Logging note: captured sample of failing stream session: stack frames indicate long-running KV eviction during prefix lookup. Will file follow-up with eng-runtime.
ryan_oncall: Handing this over to eli for sustained mitigation and postmortem. I'll go to the customer bridge in 10.
eli_sre: Taking over. I'll keep the streaming throttle in place and gradually relax when p95 stable < 1.2s for 30m. Creating an internal ticket: INFRA-17698.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback? None triggered.
maya_devex: Thanks team. Will collate logs and sample prompts to help runtime eng.
john_cs: Customers updated; acme wants a postmortem.
eli_sre: Noted. Assigning PM follow-up to lina_pm.
ryan_oncall: Closing my shift notes. If latency resurges, escalate to oncall-senior and consider targeted model-quantization route. :white_check_mark:
